name: janas
description: Code with a model of your own machine: Janas-LLM installed, its models chosen for your memory, and Continue, llama.vscode or Cline set up to use them. Nothing leaves the machine.

janas.path.description: The folder of a Janas you installed yourself (where janas-setup is). Empty: the one this extension installs and updates.

janas.startServers.description: Start the servers when the editor starts, once Janas is set up.

janas.checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, say when a new version of Janas is out (it is installed only if you say so).

janas.monitor.description: Start Janas's servers with their page of the engine at work (/monitor: speeds, the expert cache, where the time goes, inside the layers on request). Counters and times only, never the text.

walkthroughs.title: Janas: code with a model of your own machine
walkthroughs.description: Four steps, and nothing leaves the machine.

steps.title: Set up Janas
steps.description:
Janas is downloaded from its GitHub releases, checked, and installed in a folder of its own; then the rest of these steps follow by themselves.
[Set up Janas](command:janas.setUp)

steps.title: A model for this machine
steps.description:
The models are listed with the memory each wants; the ones made for code come first, and the one starred fits your memory best. The download shows its progress in a notification.
[Download a model](command:janas.getModel)

steps.title: Something to chat and complete code with
steps.description:
Janas gives the model; the chat, the edits and the completion as you type come from another extension that talks to it: Continue (all of them), llama.vscode (completion alone) or Cline (an agent).
[Install one](command:janas.chooseExtension)

steps.title: Ask it something
steps.description:
Open the chat of the extension you chose (Continue: its icon in the side bar), pick the model whose name begins with "Janas", and ask. To have the code written into a file: Apply on a block of the answer, or Ctrl+I in the file, or Continue's Agent mode with a model made for code.
[Janas's commands](command:janas.menu)
